sources.title: Gemma 2: Improving Open Language Models at a Practical Size
sources.snippet: We observe overall a massive improvement in our models compared to previous versions, by up to 10% in some benchmarks for the 9B model. The two 2B models were trained with a similar number of tokens (2T for Gemma 2 and 3T for Gemma 1) and we still observe a significant improvement for the new models.
